$comment: Champion ROLE id -> name. Static game metadata, not account data: a champion's role never changes, and every account sees the same table. Published here because heroes[].roleId in export-schema.json is an opaque int without it. Source: the game's own IL2CPP `HeroRole` enum, read live off build 11.67.0 (RslCompanionExtraction, `BlessingProbe --rolenames`).

roles.name: Evolve
roles.note: Ascension fodder (Chickens). Declared by the enum and by the l10n table; not yet observed on a live roster, because the client does not hydrate a HeroType for copies it has never rendered and these never are.

roles.name: Xp
roles.note: Levelling fodder. Same caveat as Evolve.
